title: Hurricane Florence – SC National Guard responds
description: Members of the South Carolina National Guard and Florida Task Force Two, along with local fire and police departments, conducted search and rescue operations via high water vehicles and swift water crafts in the Bucksport area of South Carolina, Sept. 24-27, 2018. Local citizens are cautioned to “turn around, don’t drown” if they come across cones, barriers or flooded roads when traveling in affected areas of S.C. (U.S. Army National Guard Video by Sgt. Kati Stacy)

transcript.text: Recent flooding in the PD region of South Carolina brought together many different organizations
to work hand in hand to keep local citizens safe.
Private Nathaniel Effort and Task Force Leader Scott Dean were in the Buxport area helping
with the search and rescue efforts.
It's been seamless working with the military, the DEA, local fire department, local police.
Everybody has one mission and that's for the safety of everybody within the counties
and in the state of South Carolina.
We're assisting the fire department, police departments, EMS crews and they need help.
All of the teams involved emphasized the importance of local citizens listening to the warnings
from state and local governments and being prepared for every outcome in order to keep
themselves and their loved ones safe.
We have one objective and that's to make sure that everybody is safe and they get to
go home to their families at the end of the day.
As water levels begin to subside, these teams stand ready to be called up at a moment's
Army Sergeant Katie Stacey, Buxport, South Carolina.
